summary.plain: Using all of its 2018 data, PROSPECT found no sign of a sterile neutrino at mass splittings of 0.2 to 20 eV squared. It excluded regions above 3 eV squared that no earlier ground experiment had covered and ruled out the best-fit point claimed by the Neutrino-4 experiment at more than five standard deviations.
summary.technical: Positron spectra from six reactor-detector distance ranges are statistically consistent; the data exclude at 95 % CL sterile-neutrino regions above 3 eV^2, including all space below 10 eV^2 suggested by the strengthened Gallium Anomaly, and rule out the Neutrino-4 best-fit point at more than 5 sigma.

title: Final Search for Short-Baseline Neutrino Oscillations with the PROSPECT-I Detector at HFIR
why_it_matters: The final PROSPECT-I word on eV-scale sterile neutrinos at reactors, and a direct refutation of the one experiment that had claimed to see them.
